preparation: Mechanical crop extraction, nearest-neighbor resizing and native-grid canvases. No original-game or Stardew Valley artwork copied.

prompts.crops: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art game inventory SPRITE ATLAS. Make exactly 8 separate crop sprites, arranged in an exact 4-column by 2-row regular grid with EQUAL sized cells and generous transparent gutters. One object centered in each cell, no overlap. Top row left to right: cream parsnip root with green leaves; two earthy brown potatoes; golden corn cob with green husk; golden wheat stalk bundle. Bottom row left to right: fresh green hops cone cluster; red strawberry with leaf crown; golden yellow ridged starfruit; mysterious ancient blue-teal fruit with deep purple leaves. Original artwork for a cozy farm expansion in a gritty space-station pawnshop. Crisp hand-drawn pixel art with dark brown one-pixel outline, soft earthy colors, limited palette, clean readable silhouette, 3/4 inventory view. Each sprite should read well at 32x48 pixels. No text, no labels, no numbers, no grid lines, no shadows outside the objects. Genuine transparent alpha background everywhere between objects. Do not depict any seed bags or bottles. The 4x2 equal grid composition is essential for mechanical slicing.
prompts.seeds: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art game inventory SPRITE ATLAS. Make exactly 8 separate small paper seed sachet sprites, arranged in an exact 4-column by 2-row regular grid with EQUAL sized cells and generous transparent gutters. One packet centered in each cell. All packets same shape: worn cream kraft-paper rectangle, folded top, small botanical crop illustration on the front, no writing. Top row left to right: parsnip seed packet with cream root drawing; potato seed packet with brown potato drawing; corn seed packet with yellow cob drawing; wheat seed packet with gold stalk drawing. Bottom row left to right: hops packet with green cones; strawberry packet with red strawberry; starfruit packet with golden starfruit; ancient fruit packet with a blue-teal fruit and purple leaves. Original cozy farming assets in a gritty space-station pawnshop. Crisp pixel art, dark brown one-pixel outline, earthy muted colors, limited palette, readable at 16x32 pixels. No text, letters, numbers, logos, grid lines or external shadows. Genuine transparent alpha background between the packets. 4x2 equal grid is essential for mechanical slicing.
prompts.crop_cleanup: Clean transparency of the eight crop silhouettes while preserving exact 4x2 layout, colors and designs. Remove external red/yellow fringe pixels and shadows, use alpha 0 outside each crop.
prompts.seed_cleanup: Clean transparency of the eight seed-packet silhouettes while preserving exact 4x2 layout and drawings. Remove all stray colored pixels, dust, background, halos and external shadows, use alpha 0 outside each packet.
prompts.farmer: Create a TRUE transparent PNG game character sprite, single farmer full body, isolated cutout. SIMPLE hard edged low resolution PIXEL ART, exactly like a 64x192 pixel adventure-game standing character enlarged with nearest-neighbor. A middle-aged male farmer with straw hat, short gray beard, olive plaid shirt, denim overalls and brown boots, small seed satchel. Centered full figure, hat and boots entirely visible, generous empty margin. The only opaque pixels may belong to the farmer's hat, body, clothes, bag and boots. Every other pixel must have alpha 0. Absolutely no black backdrop, no brown vignette, no blue glow, no ambient light behind him, no aura, no shadows, no stage, no ground, no lighting gradients. Flat 2D inventory NPC sprite. No text. Original character.
